definitions.explanation: The current day. Used as a time expression without a particle in most cases.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何曜日|なんようび}→曜日：03877_youbi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What day of the week is today?
I'm going to see a movie today.
examples.notes: No particle needed before {今日|きょう}

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありがとうございました→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧。
{今日|きょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Today's weather is very nice, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{会|あ}えません→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I can't meet up today because I have work from morning until night.

notes:
{今日|きょう} means 'today' and is one of the most essential time words in Japanese.

READINGS:
- きょう: standard, everyday
- こんにち: formal, appears in こんにちは (hello)

TIME SEQUENCE:
- ⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧: day before yesterday
- ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧: yesterday
- {今日|きょう}: today
- ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧: tomorrow
- ⟦あさって→あさって：00828_asatte⟧: day after tomorrow

USAGE:
Like other time nouns, {今日|きょう} typically appears without a particle: {今日|きょう}⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧ (I'll go today).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {今日|きょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧: today's weather
- {今日|きょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from today
- {今日|きょう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until today
- {今日|きょう}{中|じゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: within today, by today
- {今日|きょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありがとうございました→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧: Thank you for today (polite parting phrase)
